title: Verify DEHU listing holder and reject malformed pending responses
notes: The authorized sweep verified the JSON items array and the authenticated username explicitly because the built-in pending reader accepts missing or discarded items as empty and the CLI does not bind the session to the requested holder.
done_when: The CLI checks a requested or certificate-derived holder before listing and does not treat malformed pending pages as empty.
result: Verify DEHU listing holder and reject malformed pending responses
evidence: Focused tests reject a mismatched authenticated holder, missing or invalid items, and a repeated full page. The built dehu list verified a real representative certificate via its default entity NIF and a personal certificate via --nif; both returned explicitly empty pending lists without opening anything.
